title: Am I ready for the lecture?

screens.title: Am I ready for the lecture?
screens.text: Nine questions: one for each objective, then two combined questions in which you build an AVL tree and search it. If you miss a question, it comes back once in a new form. This is still private practice.

screens.title: Your readiness report
screens.text: For each objective you see Ready or Revise, with a link to the matching examples. Answers you got wrong while marked Sure are flagged, because those ideas are worth another look. Your overall title is shown at the top.

listenFor: Deleting a node with two children (delete by copying), and the extra rebalancing it can need.
The deletion cases that need a double rotation.
How the four insertion cases are coded, and why only one fix is needed.

screens.title: Your question for the lecture
screens.text: Write down one question you would like to ask in the lecture. It is added to your list, together with any questions the app suggested.

screens.title: Certificate of completion
screens.text: Type your name to generate a certificate that shows your name, the lessons you completed, your title and today’s date. The name is used only for the certificate and is not stored by the app.
